name: Islamic Calligraphy Wall Art – Set of 3 Wooden Frames (8x11” & 12x16”) with Easy Wall Mounting
description: Transform your living space with this elegant 3-piece Islamic Calligraphy Wall Art Set, designed to bring both aesthetic charm and spiritual serenity to your home. Each frame features beautifully rendered Arabic calligraphy with English translations, including Al Hamdu Lillah, Ayatul Kursi, and Subhan Allah—phrases that inspire gratitude, protection, and praise.Crafted from high-quality wooden material, these frames offer a warm, natural finish that complements both modern and traditional interiors. The soft watercolor backgrounds in blush pink and peach tones, accented with subtle gold detailing, add a touch of sophistication and tranquility to any room.Available in two versatile sizes—8x11 inches and 12x16 inches—this set is perfect for small nooks or larger feature walls. Each frame comes with double-sided tape for hassle-free wall mounting, making it easy to refresh your decor without the need for nails or tools.
